notes: Adds a nested class SkipDummySpecs implements org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExecutionCondition, written with fully qualified names and no import, that disables the tests whenever the CI environment variable is set, and registers it with @org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith(BaseFakerTest.SkipDummySpecs.class) on BaseFakerTest. Every test in the class and its subclasses is disabled on CI. Rejected with disable/execution_condition under the ruling that an ExecutionCondition implemented through a qualified name counts like one reached through an import. The class is declared in a file the checker reads, so the @ExtendWith it is registered with is judged by the same rule. Adapted: built on the pre image of reject-parameterized-allow-zero-invocations (BaseFakerTest.java at the parent of the datafaker-net/datafaker PR 1520 commit); the annotation line and the ten line class are hand written, and every context line is the pre image's own. No method target: the condition applies to every test in the class. Not from IDoFT: neither the repository nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
